name: Store Factory: Brand Copy
description: Store factory: a brand copy's Approve tap in Telegram runs the copy through the install service (DTJ Store Builder), step by step, then tells the person who tapped.

parameters.content:
## Brand copy (one Approve tap per import)
Started by the Telegram bot when someone taps **Approve** under a store job's brand copy. Every step asks the install service to copy the next few products, collections or policy pages from the plan the store job kept there; the person's name goes with every step. Nothing the store has is changed or deleted (src/copy.js). Source in git: `n8n/store-factory/`.
